article_title: C# 管道错误处理：Result、异常与短路
core_theme: C# 管道需要把预期拒绝、意外异常、调用方取消和成功结果区分开，并让短路、幂等、重试与遥测边界清晰可见。
reader_takeaway: 看懂一个带验证、库存预留和收据生成的失败感知管道，知道哪些结果应返回 Result，哪些错误应抛出，以及副作用后的重试边界。
summary_angle: 同一条管道里，预期拒绝应该有类型并立即短路，取消应保持协作语义，意外异常应保留诊断信息；副作用阶段只在可重复安全的边界重试。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文开头与 Separate Expected Rejection From Unexpected Failure：成功、预期拒绝、取消和意外失败需要分开处理。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 让一条主流程在中央出现四个清晰的终点门，分别以不同颜色表达成功、拒绝、取消和异常，保持抽象且不画真实 UI。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 A Complete Failure-Aware Pipeline 与 Short-Circuiting Must Be Part of the Contract：验证失败后不进入库存预留。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 左侧验证闸门在拒绝路径上关闭后续管道，表现明确的短路动作，后面的副作用区域保持未触发。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 Partial Effects Change the Retry Decision 与 Give Retry to One Repeat-Safe Boundary：库存预留使用稳定 OperationId，并由一个边界拥有重试。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 中部库存预留节点由一把带钥匙孔的安全锁保护，旁边只有一条回退线，表达幂等键与单一重试边界。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 Cancellation、Unexpected Exceptions 与 Instrument Outcomes：取消保持协作路径，异常重新抛出，遥测使用有限的 outcome 值。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 右侧收据出口上方保留简洁的追踪光线和有限状态标记，背景不出现日志、图表或敏感输入。

main_metaphor: 一条穿过古堡闸门的工程管道，每个闸门决定继续、短路、取消或把异常交给上层。
primary_subject: 带验证、库存预留和收据出口的 C# 失败感知管道
subject_action: 管道正在让订单经过验证闸门，在副作用边界执行一次受控重试，并把不同终态分流到清晰的出口。
composition: 轻微斜向推进的横向三阶段管道，中央聚焦验证与库存边界，左侧输入，右侧多个终态出口，保留宽幅留白。
selected_style_prompt_descriptor: dark gothic illustration, pointed arches, lace shadows, candlelit contrast, ornate black shapes, restrained horror mood
selected_style_reason: 用户未指定风格，本篇从风格池随机选中。
style_safety_note: 最终 prompt 使用安全的暗黑哥特视觉描述词，不要求复刻品牌、工作室或艺术家。
avoid: 真实 IDE 或代码截图
伪造的日志、图表、坐标轴、仪表盘或终端输出
把异常画成通用机器人或骷髅
无关的齿轮、漂浮芯片、代码雨和装饰性 HUD
密集文字、无关图标拼贴、水印和 prompt 残留
reference_strategy: 纯文本生成，不使用原文 hero 图；画面只借用文章中的管道阶段和结果分类。
draft_goal: 第一轮验证横向管道、验证短路、副作用重试边界和四种终态是否能在宽幅画面中一眼读懂。
revision_targets: 如果画面过于恐怖，降低哥特装饰并提高技术结构的清晰度
如果路径过于像真实流程图，改成更具叙事性的古堡闸门概念场景
如果文字变形，删除非必要标签，只保留 Result
final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover illustration for a Chinese technology blog, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Primary request: create a polished wide editorial technical illustration about error handling in C# pipelines. Theme: distinguish success, expected rejection, caller cancellation, and unexpected exception, while making short-circuiting, idempotency, retry ownership, and bounded telemetry visible. Summary angle: expected rejection stops the next stage, cancellation remains cooperative, unexpected exceptions preserve diagnostics, and one repeat-safe side-effect boundary owns retry. Information blocks: a C# input document; a validation gate that closes later work; a locked inventory boundary with one retry path and a stable idempotency key; four colored terminal outcome rails on the right. Main metaphor: an engineering pipeline passing through gothic gates. Subject: a failure-aware C# pipeline. Subject action: move an order through validation, hold the side-effect boundary behind an idempotency lock, and route each terminal outcome to a clear exit. Composition/framing: horizontal left-to-right flow, three gothic gates, central lock as focal subject, four outcome rails on the right, one dominant focal subject and 2-4 supporting beats in a wide 2.35:1 frame. Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with dark gothic illustration, pointed arches, lace shadows, candlelit contrast, ornate black shapes, restrained horror mood, precise readable engineering forms, no imitation of a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: deep indigo, charcoal, cool cyan, restrained amber gold, muted red. Visible text policy: allow only a clean C# mark and at most one short label Result; no poster title, long sentences, English slogans, fake UI labels, fake charts, fake metrics, or fake terminal output. Constraints and avoid: remove bottom legend strips, numbered step badges, excessive text, skulls, generic robots, floating chips, code rain, neon cityscapes, giant HUD overlays, unrelated gears, watermarks, and prompt residue.
